description: Explore. On the E007 Muon incumbent, switch to batch 1536 with Muon lr 0.205 and momentum 0.655 (Hiverge settings). Use the same 9.0 epochs (drop_last, so about 292 steps) and scale the SGD-group lr linearly with batch size. Warm up the new batch shape in build.
